7adf5a44fd8a3bb56c9e450a653218773dc4e531.CompletionText: Good day, $C! Did you come to Thunder Bluff for our celebrations?  Or are you here to rest a weary hoof between hunts?

7ae01c75444350cf67d19c1604db880d2db6bd18.Text: Enough talk.  By the time I'm through with you, not even the worgs are going to want to go near your corpse.
